parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text:
A truck R of mass 9400 kg moves with constant acceleration in a straight line down a slope,
as illustrated in Fig. 3.1.
At point A the speed of the truck is 13 m s^{-1} and at point B the speed of the truck is 22 m s^{-1}.
A and B are a distance of 180 m apart.
parts.question_text_latex:
A truck R of mass 9400 kg moves with constant acceleration in a straight line down a slope,
as illustrated in Fig. 3.1.
At point A the speed of the truck is 13 m $s^{-1}$ and at point B the speed of the truck is 22 m $s^{-1}$.
A and B are a distance of 180 m apart.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the acceleration of the truck between A and B.
acceleration = m s^{-2}
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the acceleration of the truck between A and B.
$acceleration = m s^{-2} $

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Determine the gain in kinetic energy of the truck between A and B.
gain in kinetic energy = J
parts.question_text_latex:
Determine the gain in kinetic energy of the truck between A and B.
gain in kinetic energy = J

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A short time after passing point B truck R moves in a straight line on horizontal ground. The
driver of the truck applies the brakes. Fig. 3.2 shows the variation with time of the momentum
of the truck.
parts.question_text_latex:
A short time after passing point B truck R moves in a straight line on horizontal ground. The
driver of the truck applies the brakes. Fig. 3.2 shows the variation with time of the momentum
of the truck.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Show that the average resultant force F acting on truck R between time t = 0 and t = 15 s
is –1.2 × 10^{4} N.
parts.question_text_latex:
Show that the average resultant force F acting on truck R between time t = 0 and t = 15 s
is –$1.2 \times 10^{4}\,\mathrm{N}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.question_text:
An identical truck S has the same initial momentum as truck R. Truck S experiences a
constant force equal to the force F in (b)(ii).
State and explain whether truck S will take more, less or the same amount of time to
come to rest as truck R.
